text:
alex: Hey team — PR #8427 is ready for merge but the canary shows a tail p95 bump on the 4k longseq workload. Asking for quick eyes and 2 approvals so we can either merge or revert before tomorrow's deploy window. Details below.

maria: linking the artifacts I used: https://artifacts.internal/bench/8427/ (bench summary + raw traces)

sam: quick question — is this visible in prod canary or just the CI bench?

alex: Only CI canary so far. We ran the same commit on the small internal canary cluster (tag: canary-rc-8427) — results attached by bench-bot.

bench-bot: bench summary for pr#8427 on canary-rc-8427:
```
workload         p50(ms)  p95(ms)  mem_rss(MB)
shortseq-v1      12       42       3120
4k-longseq-v2    85       610      8240  <-- p95 up from 420
throughput(tok/s) baseline: 28.3 -> current: 26.1
```
Artifact: https://artifacts.internal/bench/8427/report.html

priyanka: 610ms p95 is concerning. Do we have a heatmap or stack sample that points to KV-cache or scheduling?

alex: I inspected traces, tail is mostly in kv-shard wait + allocator contention. Small increase in microbatch creation time. Stack samples: https://artifacts.internal/bench/8427/stack-samples.json

maria: Is this the allocator change from the PR (batch horizon tweak)? If so, could we gate it behind a flag?

alex: Yes, this PR changes allocator windowing and a small prefetch path. I can add a runtime flag to opt out prefetch for longseqs quickly. Will push a patch if we decide to hold merge.

sam: My take: if we can add a short-lived flag and run a 1hr canary, fine to merge after that. Otherwise mark hold. Need at least one more approval from infra owners. @maria can you be that owner?

maria: I can review + approve after you add the flag and re-run the short canary. If the 1hr canary matches baseline p95, :thumbsup:.

priyanka: adding note — if rollback is needed, let's prepare a revert plan. Who owns the rollback? @alex?

alex: I'll own the revert plan and a small patch to gate prefetch. Plan: if canary fails we revert commit and open a hotfix to reintroduce optimizations behind flag. I'll push flag patch in ~20m.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reminder: next free merge slot at 2026-03-18T22:00Z. If PR not merged before, it will be batched into next window.

sam: Sounds good. I'll wait for the flag patch and rerun the canary bench. Once bench-bot posts ~baseline metrics, I can approve.

alex: pushed flag patch to branch, triggered canary: https://ci.internal/canary/8427-flag-run. bench-bot will post results when ready.

bench-bot: quick update (30m run): 4k-longseq-v2 p95=430ms, throughput 28.0 tok/s, mem_rss 8208MB — within acceptable delta vs baseline.

maria: OK from me after the flag and canary results. Approved in GH. :white_check_mark:

sam: Approved.

priyanka: approved too, leaving the revert plan in the PR description.

alex: thanks all — merging now. Will monitor canary metrics for 2h post-merge and post any alerts to #incidents if we see regression. :bow:
